import base64, datetime, json, os
item = _input.first().json
slug = item["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
for sub in ["", "refs", "refs/original", "shots", "audio", "audio/lines", "render", "music", "logs"]:
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, sub) if sub else root, exist_ok=True)
for i, ref in enumerate(item["refs"], 1):
    p = os.path.join(root, "refs", "original", "ref_%02d.%s" % (i, ref["ext"]))
    with open(p, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(base64.b64decode(ref["b64"]))
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
proj = {"slug": slug, "title": item["title"], "story": item["story"],
        "created_at": now, "updated_at": now, "status": "created", "stages": {},
        "counts": {"refs": len(item["refs"])}, "notes": ""}
with open(os.path.join(root, "project.json"), "w") as fh:
    json.dump(proj, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
return [{"json": {"ok": True, "root": root, "slug": slug, "refs": len(item["refs"])}}]

import glob, json, os, subprocess
item = _input.first().json
slug = item["slug"]
refs_dir = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug + "/refs"
srcs = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(refs_dir, "original", "*")))
if not srcs:
    raise RuntimeError("no reference images found in " + refs_dir + "/original")
normalized = []
i = 0
for src in srcs:
    i += 1
    dst = os.path.join(refs_dir, "ref_%02d.jpg" % i)
    r = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", src,
                        "-vf", "scale='min(1024,iw)':-2", "-q:v", "4", dst],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    ok = r.returncode == 0 and os.path.exists(dst)
    normalized.append({"file": os.path.basename(dst), "ok": ok,
                       "bytes": os.path.getsize(dst) if os.path.exists(dst) else 0,
                       "err": (r.stderr or "")[-300:] if not ok else ""})
if not any(n["ok"] for n in normalized):
    raise RuntimeError("ffmpeg failed to normalize any reference image: " + json.dumps(normalized))
return [{"json": {"ok": True, "slug": slug, "normalized": normalized}}]
